control_model_evidence: src/tau2/domains/retail/environment.py builds Environment(domain, policy, tools) with no user_tools and rejects solo_mode; only the agent has tools, the user is a pure LLM simulator. (The dual-control domain telecom imports TelecomUserTools.)
split_source: data/tau2/domains/retail/split_tasks.json (at the pinned commit): train=74, test=40, base=114 (base = train + test, train and test disjoint).

dev.selection: first 10 train task ids by numeric order (deterministic)

measurement.note: The measurement baseline is sized by cost and drawn from the test split; the exact subset is chosen after the dev run measures per-task cost. The whole test split is the candidate pool.

disjointness: dev is drawn from train and measurement from test; train and test are disjoint in split_tasks.json, so the 10 dev tasks share no id with any measurement task (verified: dev ∩ test = ∅).
